---
title: "Repertoire"
description: "Your repertoire selections for all three components. Edits here sync with the individual checklist pages."
categories: [Reference, Assessment]
toc: true
toc-depth: 3
---

```{=html}
<script>
// ── Apply shared data from URL before localStorage is read ───────────────────
(function() {
  var SHARE_KEYS = ['pieces:exploring','pieces:experimenting','pieces:presenting:performing','pieces:presenting:creating','presenting:nPerf','presenting:nCrea','checklist:exploring','checklist:experimenting','checklist:presenting'];
  var m = location.search.match(/[?&]share=([^&]+)/);
  if (!m) return;
  try {
    var data = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(m[1]))));
    if (data && typeof data === 'object') {
      SHARE_KEYS.forEach(function(k) {
        if (data[k] !== undefined) localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(data[k]));
      });
    }
    history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname);
  } catch(e) {}
})();

(function () {
  // ── Shared styles ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var INP = 'font-size:.82rem;padding:.2rem .3rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:2px;background:#faf8f5;color:#2c2416;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;';
  var INP_RO = 'font-size:.82rem;padding:.2rem .3rem;border:1px solid #e0d6c8;border-radius:2px;background:#f5f3ef;color:#7a6a55;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;pointer-events:none;';
  var SEL = INP + 'cursor:pointer;';
  var TH  = 'text-align:left;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#999;padding:.3rem .3rem;border-bottom:1px solid #e0d6c8;font-weight:400;white-space:nowrap;';
  var TD  = 'padding:.25rem .2rem;vertical-align:middle;';
  var BTN = 'font-size:.78rem;padding:.2rem .5rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:#666;cursor:pointer;margin-right:.3rem;';

  function esc(s) { return (s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }

  function buildSel(id_prefix, row, field, opts, val, width) {
    var style = SEL + (width ? 'width:'+width+';' : '');
    var h = '<select data-src="'+id_prefix+'" data-row="'+row+'" data-field="'+field+'" style="'+style+'">';
    opts.forEach(function(o){ h+='<option value="'+esc(o)+'"'+(val===o?' selected':'')+'>'+(o||'—')+'</option>'; });
    return h+'</select>';
  }

  function fmtTime(totalSecs) {
    var m = Math.floor(totalSecs/60), s = totalSecs%60;
    return m + ':' + (s<10?'0':'') + s;
  }

  function calcTotal(items) {
    return items.reduce(function(sum,p){ return sum+(parseInt(p.lenMin)||0)*60+(parseInt(p.lenSec)||0); }, 0);
  }

  function timeBar(secs, maxSecs) {
    var pct = Math.min(secs/maxSecs*100, 100).toFixed(1);
    var over = secs > maxSecs;
    var ratio = Math.min(secs/maxSecs, 1);
    var barColor, timeColor;
    if (over) {
      barColor = '#c0392b'; timeColor = '#c0392b';
    } else {
      var hue = Math.round(120 + ratio*3);
      var sat = Math.round(36 + ratio*10);
      var lit = Math.round(75 - ratio*41);
      barColor = 'hsl('+hue+','+sat+'%,'+lit+'%)';
      timeColor = '#444';
    }
    return '<div style="margin:.4rem 0 .8rem;">'
      + '<div style="background:#e8e4df;border-radius:3px;height:5px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:.3rem;">'
      + '<div style="background:'+barColor+';width:'+pct+'%;height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s;"></div></div>'
      + '<span style="color:'+timeColor+';font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;">'+fmtTime(secs)+'</span>'
      + '<span style="color:#aaa;font-size:.82rem;"> / '+fmtTime(maxSecs)+' max</span>'
      + (over ? '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:.75rem;margin-left:.5rem;">&#9888; over limit</span>' : '')
      + '</div>';
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // EXPLORING (shared key with exploring-checklist.qmd)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var EXP_KEY  = 'pieces:exploring';
  var EXP_N    = 4;
  var EXP_AOI  = ['', '1', '2', '3', '4'];
  var EXP_CTX  = ['', 'Personal', 'Local', 'Global'];
  var EXP_PRAC = ['', 'Creating', 'Performing'];
  var expShow4  = false;

  function expBlank() { return {name:'',composer:'',genre:'',aoi:'',context:'',practical:''}; }
  function loadExp() {
    try { var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(EXP_KEY))||[]; while(d.length<EXP_N)d.push(expBlank()); return d.slice(0,EXP_N); }
    catch(e) { return Array(EXP_N).fill(null).map(expBlank); }
  }
  var expPieces = loadExp();
  function saveExp() { try{localStorage.setItem(EXP_KEY,JSON.stringify(expPieces));}catch(e){} }

  function renderExp() {
    var c = document.getElementById('rep-exploring');
    if (!c) return;
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.5rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>';
    ['Piece','Composer','Genre','AOI','Context','Practical exercise'].forEach(function(lbl){ h+='<th style="'+TH+'">'+lbl+'</th>'; });
    h += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
    for (var r=0; r<EXP_N; r++) {
      var hidden = (r===3 && !expShow4) ? ' style="display:none;"' : '';
      h += '<tr'+hidden+'>';
      ['name','composer','genre'].forEach(function(f){
        h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="text" data-src="exp" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="'+f+'" value="'+esc(expPieces[r][f])+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      });
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:5em;">'+buildSel('exp',r,'aoi',EXP_AOI,expPieces[r].aoi)+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:7em;">'+buildSel('exp',r,'context',EXP_CTX,expPieces[r].context)+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:9em;">'+buildSel('exp',r,'practical',EXP_PRAC,expPieces[r].practical)+'</td>';
      h += '</tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    var toggleBtn = document.getElementById('exp-toggle4th');
    if (toggleBtn) toggleBtn.textContent = expShow4 ? 'Remove 4th Piece' : 'Add 4th Piece';
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input,select').forEach(function(el){
      el.addEventListener('change', function(){
        expPieces[+el.dataset.row][el.dataset.field] = el.value;
        saveExp(); runAllAutoChecks();
      });
    });
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // EXPERIMENTING (shared key with ewm-checklist.qmd)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var EWM_KEY  = 'pieces:experimenting';
  var EWM_N    = 2;
  var EWM_AOI  = ['', '1', '2', '3', '4'];
  var EWM_CTX  = ['', 'Local', 'Global'];
  var EWM_PRACTICALS = ['Creating', 'Performing'];

  function ewmBlank() { return {name:'',composer:'',genre:'',aoi:'',context:'',practical:''}; }
  function loadEWM() {
    try { var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(EWM_KEY))||[]; while(d.length<EWM_N)d.push(ewmBlank()); return d.slice(0,EWM_N); }
    catch(e) { return Array(EWM_N).fill(null).map(ewmBlank); }
  }
  var ewmPieces = loadEWM();
  ewmPieces[0].practical = 'Creating';
  ewmPieces[1].practical = 'Performing';
  function saveEWM() { try{localStorage.setItem(EWM_KEY,JSON.stringify(ewmPieces));}catch(e){} }
  saveEWM();

  function renderEWM() {
    var c = document.getElementById('rep-experimenting');
    if (!c) return;
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.5rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>';
    ['Piece','Composer','Genre','AOI','Context'].forEach(function(lbl){ h+='<th style="'+TH+'">'+lbl+'</th>'; });
    h += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
    for (var r=0; r<EWM_N; r++) {
      h += '<tr>';
      ['name','composer','genre'].forEach(function(f){
        h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="text" data-src="ewm" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="'+f+'" value="'+esc(ewmPieces[r][f])+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      });
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:5em;">'+buildSel('ewm',r,'aoi',EWM_AOI,ewmPieces[r].aoi)+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:7em;">'+buildSel('ewm',r,'context',EWM_CTX,ewmPieces[r].context)+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:9em;color:#777;font-size:.82rem;padding-left:.4rem;">'+EWM_PRACTICALS[r]+'</td>';
      h += '</tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input,select').forEach(function(el){
      el.addEventListener('change', function(){
        ewmPieces[+el.dataset.row][el.dataset.field] = el.value;
        saveEWM(); runAllAutoChecks();
      });
    });
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // PRESENTING: PERFORMING
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var PERF_KEY   = 'pieces:presenting:performing';
  var NPERF_KEY  = 'presenting:nPerf';
  var PERF_SLOTS = 5;
  var PERF_MIN   = 3;
  var PERF_MAX   = 5;
  var PERF_MAX_SECS = 12 * 60;
  var EXCR_MAX_SECS = 2 * 60;
  var nPerf = Math.min(PERF_MAX, Math.max(PERF_MIN, parseInt(localStorage.getItem(NPERF_KEY))||4));

  var PERF_AOI = ['', '1', '2', '3', '4'];

  function perfBlank() { return {name:'',composer:'',genre:'',aoi:'',lenMin:'',lenSec:'',ensemble:false,excerptRequired:false,excerptMin:'',excerptSec:''}; }
  function loadPerf() {
    try { var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PERF_KEY))||[]; while(d.length<PERF_SLOTS)d.push(perfBlank()); return d.slice(0,PERF_SLOTS); }
    catch(e) { return Array(PERF_SLOTS).fill(null).map(perfBlank); }
  }
  var perfPieces = loadPerf();
  function savePerf() { try{localStorage.setItem(PERF_KEY,JSON.stringify(perfPieces));}catch(e){} }
  function saveNPerf() { try{localStorage.setItem(NPERF_KEY,String(nPerf));}catch(e){} }

  var EXCERPT_POLICY = "You may need or want to submit excerpts of your parts of ensemble pieces. Double-click to see more information in the Subject Guide.";

  // ── Excerpt policy popup (standalone — not relying on glossary.js internals) ─
  var _excPopup = null;
  function showExcerptPopup(btn) {
    hideExcerptPopup();
    var pop = document.createElement('div');
    pop.style.cssText = [
      'position:fixed','z-index:2147483647','box-sizing:border-box',
      'font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif',
      'font-size:.85rem','line-height:1.5','color:#fff','background:#333',
      'padding:9px 13px','border-radius:7px','max-width:360px',
      'pointer-events:none','white-space:normal'
    ].join(';');
    pop.textContent = EXCERPT_POLICY;
    document.body.appendChild(pop);
    var rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
    var vw   = window.innerWidth;
    var popW = Math.min(360, vw - 20);
    pop.style.width = popW + 'px';
    var popH = pop.offsetHeight;
    var cx   = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
    var left = Math.max(10, Math.min(cx - popW / 2, vw - popW - 10));
    var top  = (rect.top - popH - 8 >= 10) ? rect.top - popH - 8 : rect.bottom + 8;
    pop.style.left = left + 'px';
    pop.style.top  = top  + 'px';
    _excPopup = pop;
  }
  function hideExcerptPopup() {
    if (_excPopup) { _excPopup.remove(); _excPopup = null; }
  }
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!e.target.closest('.excerpt-policy-btn')) hideExcerptPopup();
  });
  window.addEventListener('scroll', hideExcerptPopup, {passive:true, capture:true});

  function renderPerf() {
    var c = document.getElementById('rep-performing');
    if (!c) return;

    // Column widths (must match excerpt table)
    var W = {name:'28%',composer:'20%',genre:'13%',aoi:'7%',min:'8%',sec:'8%',ens:'8%',exc:'8%'};

    var excHeaderBtn = '<button class="excerpt-policy-btn" style="color:#5b9bd5;font-size:.6rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:400;border:none;padding:0;background:none;cursor:help;text-decoration:underline dotted;">'
      + 'Excerpt?'
      + '</button>';

    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;table-layout:fixed;">';
    h += '<colgroup>'
      + '<col style="width:'+W.name+'"><col style="width:'+W.composer+'"><col style="width:'+W.genre+'">'
      + '<col style="width:'+W.aoi+'"><col style="width:'+W.min+'"><col style="width:'+W.sec+'">'
      + '<col style="width:'+W.ens+'"><col style="width:'+W.exc+'"></colgroup>';
    h += '<thead><tr>';
    h += '<th style="'+TH+'">Piece</th><th style="'+TH+'">Composer</th><th style="'+TH+'">Genre</th>';
    h += '<th style="'+TH+'">AOI</th>';
    h += '<th style="'+TH+'">Min</th><th style="'+TH+'">Sec</th>';
    h += '<th style="'+TH+'font-size:.6rem;overflow:hidden;">Ensemble?</th>';
    h += '<th style="'+TH+'font-size:.6rem;text-align:right;">'+excHeaderBtn+'</th>';
    h += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for (var r=0; r<nPerf; r++) {
      var p = perfPieces[r];
      h += '<tr>';
      ['name','composer','genre'].forEach(function(f){
        h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="text" data-src="perf" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="'+f+'" value="'+esc(p[f])+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      });
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'">'+buildSel('perf',r,'aoi',PERF_AOI,p.aoi)+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="99" data-src="perf" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="lenMin" value="'+esc(String(p.lenMin||''))+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="59" data-src="perf" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="lenSec" value="'+esc(String(p.lenSec||''))+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      var ensChecked = p.ensemble ? ' checked' : '';
      var excDisabled = p.ensemble ? '' : ' disabled';
      var excChecked = (p.ensemble && p.excerptRequired) ? ' checked' : '';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'text-align:center;"><input type="checkbox" data-src="perf" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="ensemble"'+ensChecked+' style="cursor:pointer;width:1em;height:1em;display:block;margin:0 auto;" /></td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'text-align:center;"><input type="checkbox" data-src="perf" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="excerptRequired"'+excChecked+excDisabled+' style="cursor:pointer;width:1em;height:1em;display:block;margin:0 auto;" /></td>';
      h += '</tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table>';

    // Total row
    var visiblePieces = perfPieces.slice(0, nPerf);
    var totalSecs = calcTotal(visiblePieces);
    h += '<div style="margin:.3rem 0 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">'
      + '<span style="font-size:.75rem;color:#999;">Max: 12:00</span>'
      + '<div>'+timeBar(totalSecs, PERF_MAX_SECS)+'</div></div>';

    // Add/Remove piece buttons
    h += '<div style="margin:.3rem 0 .5rem;">'
      + '<button data-action="perf-remove" style="'+BTN+'"'+(nPerf<=PERF_MIN?' disabled style="'+BTN+'opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;"':'')+'>&#8722; Remove Piece</button>'
      + '<button data-action="perf-add" style="'+BTN+'"'+(nPerf>=PERF_MAX?' disabled style="'+BTN+'opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;"':'')+'>&#43; Add Piece</button>'
      + '</div>';

    c.innerHTML = h;

    c.querySelectorAll('input[type="text"],input[type="number"],select').forEach(function(el){
      el.addEventListener('change', function(){
        perfPieces[+el.dataset.row][el.dataset.field] = el.value;
        savePerf(); renderPerf(); renderExcerpts(); runAllAutoChecks();
      });
    });

    c.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]').forEach(function(el){
      el.addEventListener('change', function(){
        var row = +el.dataset.row;
        var field = el.dataset.field;
        perfPieces[row][field] = el.checked;
        if (field==='ensemble' && !el.checked) {
          perfPieces[row].excerptRequired = false;
          perfPieces[row].excerptMin = '';
          perfPieces[row].excerptSec = '';
        }
        savePerf(); renderPerf(); renderExcerpts(); runAllAutoChecks();
      });
    });

    c.querySelector('[data-action="perf-add"]') && c.querySelector('[data-action="perf-add"]').addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (nPerf < PERF_MAX) { nPerf++; saveNPerf(); renderPerf(); renderExcerpts(); }
    });
    c.querySelector('[data-action="perf-remove"]') && c.querySelector('[data-action="perf-remove"]').addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (nPerf > PERF_MIN) { nPerf--; saveNPerf(); renderPerf(); renderExcerpts(); }
    });

    // Single-click: show policy popup. Double-click: navigate to subject guide p.57.
    c.querySelectorAll('.excerpt-policy-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (_excPopup) { hideExcerptPopup(); } else { showExcerptPopup(btn); }
      });
      btn.addEventListener('dblclick', function(e){
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        hideExcerptPopup();
        window.location.href = '../resources/subject-guide.html#page=57';
      });
    });
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // PRESENTING: PERFORMING EXCERPTS (conditional)
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function renderExcerpts() {
    var container = document.getElementById('rep-excerpts-container');
    if (!container) return;

    var excerptPieces = perfPieces.slice(0, nPerf).filter(function(p){ return p.ensemble && p.excerptRequired; });
    var indices = [];
    perfPieces.slice(0, nPerf).forEach(function(p, i){ if (p.ensemble && p.excerptRequired) indices.push(i); });

    if (excerptPieces.length === 0) {
      container.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    // Same column widths as Performing table
    var h = '<h3 style="margin-top:1.5rem;"><em>Performing Excerpts</em></h3>';
    h += '<p style="font-size:.85rem;color:#888;margin-top:-.5rem;">One excerpt per ensemble performance. Max 2:00 total.</p>';
    h += '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;table-layout:fixed;">';
    h += '<colgroup>'
      + '<col style="width:65%">'   // spans Piece+Composer+Genre+AOI (30+17+11+7)
      + '<col style="width:6%">'    // Min — aligned with Performing
      + '<col style="width:6%">'    // Sec — aligned with Performing
      + '<col style="width:23%">'   // spacer (Ensemble + Excerpt cols: 7+16)
      + '</colgroup>';
    h += '<thead><tr>';
    h += '<th style="'+TH+'">Piece</th>';
    h += '<th style="'+TH+'">Min</th>';
    h += '<th style="'+TH+'">Sec</th>';
    h += '<th style="'+TH+'"></th>';
    h += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    indices.forEach(function(i){
      var p = perfPieces[i];
      var label = 'Excerpt from ' + (p.name || '(untitled)');
      h += '<tr>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="text" value="'+esc(label)+'" style="'+INP_RO+'" readonly /></td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="99" data-src="excr" data-row="'+i+'" data-field="excerptMin" value="'+esc(String(p.excerptMin||''))+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="59" data-src="excr" data-row="'+i+'" data-field="excerptSec" value="'+esc(String(p.excerptSec||''))+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'"></td>';
      h += '</tr>';
    });
    h += '</tbody></table>';

    // Excerpt subtotal
    var excrSecs = indices.reduce(function(sum,i){
      return sum + (parseInt(perfPieces[i].excerptMin)||0)*60 + (parseInt(perfPieces[i].excerptSec)||0);
    }, 0);
    h += '<div style="margin:.3rem 0 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">'
      + '<span style="font-size:.75rem;color:#999;">Max: 2:00</span>'
      + '<div>'+timeBar(excrSecs, EXCR_MAX_SECS)+'</div></div>';

    container.innerHTML = h;

    container.querySelectorAll('input[type="number"]').forEach(function(el){
      el.addEventListener('change', function(){
        perfPieces[+el.dataset.row][el.dataset.field] = el.value;
        savePerf(); renderExcerpts();
      });
    });
  }

  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // PRESENTING: CREATING
  // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var CREA_KEY   = 'pieces:presenting:creating';
  var NCREA_KEY  = 'presenting:nCrea';
  var CREA_SLOTS = 3;
  var CREA_MIN   = 1;
  var CREA_MAX   = 3;
  var CREA_MAX_SECS = 6 * 60;
  var nCrea = Math.min(CREA_MAX, Math.max(CREA_MIN, parseInt(localStorage.getItem(NCREA_KEY))||2));

  var CREA_AOI = ['', '1', '2', '3', '4'];
  var CREA_METHOD_OPTS = ['', 'Staff Notation', 'DAW', 'Alternative notation', 'Improvisation'];

  function creaBlank() { return {name:'',method:'',genre:'',aoi:'',lenMin:'',lenSec:''}; }
  function loadCrea() {
    try { var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CREA_KEY))||[]; while(d.length<CREA_SLOTS)d.push(creaBlank()); return d.slice(0,CREA_SLOTS); }
    catch(e) { return Array(CREA_SLOTS).fill(null).map(creaBlank); }
  }
  var creaPieces = loadCrea();
  function saveCrea() { try{localStorage.setItem(CREA_KEY,JSON.stringify(creaPieces));}catch(e){} }
  function saveNCrea() { try{localStorage.setItem(NCREA_KEY,String(nCrea));}catch(e){} }

  function renderCrea() {
    var c = document.getElementById('rep-creating');
    if (!c) return;

    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.5rem;table-layout:fixed;">';
    h += '<colgroup><col style="width:35%"><col style="width:24%"><col style="width:18%"><col style="width:7%"><col style="width:8%"><col style="width:8%"></colgroup>';
    h += '<thead><tr>';
    ['Piece','Method','Genre','AOI','Min','Sec'].forEach(function(lbl){ h+='<th style="'+TH+'">'+lbl+'</th>'; });
    h += '</tr></thead><tbody>';

    for (var r=0; r<nCrea; r++) {
      var p = creaPieces[r];
      h += '<tr>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="text" data-src="crea" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="name" value="'+esc(p.name||'')+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'">'+buildSel('crea',r,'method',CREA_METHOD_OPTS,(p.method||''))+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="text" data-src="crea" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="genre" value="'+esc(p.genre||'')+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'">'+buildSel('crea',r,'aoi',CREA_AOI,p.aoi)+'</td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="99" data-src="crea" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="lenMin" value="'+esc(String(p.lenMin||''))+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="59" data-src="crea" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="lenSec" value="'+esc(String(p.lenSec||''))+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      h += '</tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table>';

    var visiblePieces = creaPieces.slice(0, nCrea);
    var totalSecs = calcTotal(visiblePieces);
    h += '<div style="margin:.3rem 0 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;">'
      + '<span style="font-size:.75rem;color:#999;">Max: 6:00</span>'
      + '<div>'+timeBar(totalSecs, CREA_MAX_SECS)+'</div></div>';

    h += '<div style="margin:.3rem 0 .5rem;">'
      + '<button data-action="crea-remove" style="'+BTN+'"'+(nCrea<=CREA_MIN?' disabled style="'+BTN+'opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;"':'')+'>&#8722; Remove Piece</button>'
      + '<button data-action="crea-add" style="'+BTN+'"'+(nCrea>=CREA_MAX?' disabled style="'+BTN+'opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed;"':'')+'>&#43; Add Piece</button>'
      + '</div>';

    c.innerHTML = h;

    c.querySelectorAll('input,select').forEach(function(el){
      el.addEventListener('change', function(){
        creaPieces[+el.dataset.row][el.dataset.field] = el.value;
        saveCrea(); renderCrea(); runAllAutoChecks();
      });
    });

    c.querySelector('[data-action="crea-add"]') && c.querySelector('[data-action="crea-add"]').addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (nCrea < CREA_MAX) { nCrea++; saveNCrea(); renderCrea(); }
    });
    c.querySelector('[data-action="crea-remove"]') && c.querySelector('[data-action="crea-remove"]').addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (nCrea > CREA_MIN) { nCrea--; saveNCrea(); renderCrea(); }
    });
  }

  // ── Auto-check indicators ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function setInd(id, state) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('auto-checked', 'auto-error');
    if (state === true)    el.classList.add('auto-checked');
    if (state === 'error') el.classList.add('auto-error');
  }

  function initACLists() {
    var expAC = document.getElementById('ac-exploring');
    if (expAC) expAC.innerHTML = '<ul class="ac-list">'
      + '<li><span class="auto-indicator" id="ac-exp-aoi"></span>At least <strong>two different areas of inquiry</strong> are represented across all pieces</li>'
      + '<li><span class="auto-indicator" id="ac-exp-ctx"></span>All <strong>three contexts</strong> are covered: personal, local, and global</li>'
      + '<li><span class="auto-indicator" id="ac-exp-cre"></span>Creating exercise stimulus is identified</li>'
      + '<li><span class="auto-indicator" id="ac-exp-adp"></span>Performed adaptation stimulus is identified: <strong>local or global context</strong>, different AOI from creating</li>'
      + '</ul>';

    var ewmAC = document.getElementById('ac-experimenting');
    if (ewmAC) ewmAC.innerHTML = '<ul class="ac-list">'
      + '<li><span class="auto-indicator" id="ac-ewm-aoi"></span>At least <strong>two different areas of inquiry</strong> are represented across all pieces</li>'
      + '<li><span class="auto-indicator" id="ac-ewm-four"></span>All <strong>four areas of inquiry</strong> are covered between Exploring and Experimenting</li>'
      + '<li><span class="auto-indicator" id="ac-ewm-ctx"></span>Both <strong>contexts</strong> are covered: local and global</li>'
      + '</ul>';

    var presAC = document.getElementById('ac-presenting');
    if (presAC) presAC.innerHTML = '<ul class="ac-list">'
      + '<li><span class="auto-indicator" id="ac-pres-four"></span>All <strong>four areas of inquiry</strong> are represented across all pieces</li>'
      + '</ul>';
  }

  function runAllAutoChecks() {
    var expAOIs  = expPieces.map(function(p){ return p.aoi; }).filter(Boolean);
    var expCtxs  = expPieces.map(function(p){ return p.context; }).filter(Boolean);
    var expCreat = expPieces.filter(function(p){ return p.practical === 'Creating'; });
    var expAllPerf = expPieces.filter(function(p){ return p.practical === 'Performing'; });
    var expPerf  = expAllPerf.filter(function(p){ return p.context === 'Local' || p.context === 'Global'; });

    setInd('ac-exp-aoi', new Set(expAOIs).size >= 2);
    setInd('ac-exp-ctx', expCtxs.indexOf('Personal') > -1 && expCtxs.indexOf('Local') > -1 && expCtxs.indexOf('Global') > -1);
    setInd('ac-exp-cre', expCreat.length >= 1);

    var adaptOk = expPerf.length >= 1;
    if (adaptOk && expCreat.length >= 1 && expCreat[0].aoi && expPerf[0].aoi) adaptOk = expPerf[0].aoi !== expCreat[0].aoi;
    var adaptError = false;
    if (expAllPerf.length > 0) {
      var hasPersonal = expAllPerf.some(function(p){ return p.context === 'Personal'; });
      var hasSameAOI  = expCreat.length > 0 && expAllPerf.some(function(p){
        return p.aoi && expCreat[0].aoi && p.aoi === expCreat[0].aoi;
      });
      adaptError = hasPersonal || hasSameAOI;
    }
    setInd('ac-exp-adp', adaptError ? 'error' : adaptOk);

    var ewmAOIs = ewmPieces.map(function(p){ return p.aoi; }).filter(Boolean);
    var ewmCtxs = ewmPieces.map(function(p){ return p.context; }).filter(Boolean);
    setInd('ac-ewm-aoi', new Set(ewmAOIs).size >= 2);
    var allAOIs = new Set(ewmAOIs.concat(expAOIs));
    var fourOK  = allAOIs.has('1') && allAOIs.has('2') && allAOIs.has('3') && allAOIs.has('4');
    var fourError = !fourOK && ewmAOIs.length >= EWM_N && expAOIs.length >= 3;
    setInd('ac-ewm-four', fourError ? 'error' : fourOK);
    setInd('ac-ewm-ctx', ewmCtxs.indexOf('Local') > -1 && ewmCtxs.indexOf('Global') > -1);

    var perfAOIs = perfPieces.slice(0, nPerf).map(function(p){ return p.aoi; }).filter(Boolean);
    var creaAOIs = creaPieces.slice(0, nCrea).map(function(p){ return p.aoi; }).filter(Boolean);
    var presAOIs = new Set(perfAOIs.concat(creaAOIs));
    setInd('ac-pres-four', presAOIs.has('1') && presAOIs.has('2') && presAOIs.has('3') && presAOIs.has('4'));
  }

  // ── Init ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    initACLists();
    renderExp();
    renderEWM();
    renderPerf();
    renderExcerpts();
    renderCrea();
    runAllAutoChecks();

    // Exploring 4th piece toggle
    var expBtn = document.getElementById('exp-toggle4th');
    if (expBtn) {
      expBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        expShow4 = !expShow4;
        if (!expShow4) { expPieces[3] = expBlank(); saveExp(); }
        renderExp();
        runAllAutoChecks();
      });
    }
  });

  // ── Share link ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  var SHARE_KEYS = ['pieces:exploring','pieces:experimenting','pieces:presenting:performing','pieces:presenting:creating','presenting:nPerf','presenting:nCrea','checklist:exploring','checklist:experimenting','checklist:presenting'];

  function buildShareURL() {
    var data = {};
    SHARE_KEYS.forEach(function(k) {
      var v = localStorage.getItem(k);
      if (v != null) try { data[k] = JSON.parse(v); } catch(e) { data[k] = v; }
    });
    var encoded = btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(data))));
    return location.protocol + '//' + location.host + location.pathname + '?share=' + encoded;
  }

  window.copyShareLink = function() {
    var url = buildShareURL();
    var btn  = document.getElementById('share-btn');
    var note = document.getElementById('share-note');
    function onCopied() {
      if (btn)  { btn.textContent  = 'Copied!'; setTimeout(function(){ btn.textContent  = 'Copy link'; }, 2500); }
      if (note) { note.textContent = url.length > 80 ? url.slice(0,80)+'...' : url; }
    }
    function onFailed() {
      if (btn) btn.textContent = 'Copy failed — see console';
    }
    if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(onCopied).catch(function() {
        fallbackCopy(url, onCopied, onFailed);
      });
    } else {
      fallbackCopy(url, onCopied, onFailed);
    }
  };

  function fallbackCopy(text, onOk, onFail) {
    var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = text;
    ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;opacity:0;top:0;left:0;';
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.focus(); ta.select();
    try { document.execCommand('copy') ? onOk() : onFail(); }
    catch(e) { onFail(); }
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  }
})();
</script>
<style>
.auto-indicator {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 1em; height: 1em;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid #bbb;
  background: #f0ede8;
  margin-right: .4em;
  vertical-align: middle;
  position: relative;
  top: -1px;
  cursor: default;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.auto-indicator.auto-checked { border-color: #2e7d32; background: #2e7d32; }
.auto-indicator.auto-checked::after,
.auto-indicator.auto-error::after {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  font-size: .6em;
  color: #fff;
}
.auto-indicator.auto-checked::after { content: '✓'; }
.auto-indicator.auto-error { border-color: #c0392b; background: #c0392b; }
.auto-indicator.auto-error::after  { content: '✗'; }
.ac-list { list-style: none; padding: .3rem 0; margin: .2rem 0 1rem; }
.ac-list li { margin: .3rem 0; font-size: .88rem; }
</style>
```
